title: brand-ui app-spec
description: The machine-readable contract the new-app interview produces and `brand-ui scaffold` consumes. Authored as a fenced ```json block inside app-spec.md (single source: prose for humans, this block for the engine). `brand-ui scaffold <app-spec.md>` extracts this block, validates it against this schema, and emits the app from it (`--write <dir>`).

archetype.description: App shape → the generated playbooks/templates/<archetype>.tsx + playbooks/<archetype>.md.

theme.description: Shipped theme slug (CSS slug, never display name).

title.description: App title (free text; defaults to the archetype name).

density.description: DEPRECATED alias for `taste.density` — kept so existing specs keep validating. "default" == the token dial's "comfortable". Prefer `taste.density`, which uses the shipped DensityMode vocabulary; when both are present `taste.density` wins.

taste.description: The taste profile the scaffold is built to — register x density x motion x expressiveness (stage 5 'Brand & feel'; ADR 0020). Every axis maps to a shipped token dial except `register`, which picks the BAR the surface is judged against. Omitted axes take the restrained default (product / comfortable / system / 0) — expressive is opt-in. Apply these ONLY through the dials (ThemeProvider props / data-density / data-decoration), never as hardcoded values in emitted component source.

register.description: Which bar the app is judged against. product = app UI, earned familiarity (default). brand = marketing surfaces, distinctiveness.

density.description: Density → the `data-density` dial (ThemeProvider `defaultDensity`). Rescales spacing AND the eight `--text-<role>` sizes together (#340): compact is ~11% tighter spacing with ~6% smaller role type, spacious the reverse; comfortable is the identity. Apply it through the dial, never by hardcoding smaller `text-*` in emitted source. Note the dial only reaches text that uses a ROLE utility (`text-body`/`text-meta`/…); raw `text-sm`/`text-xs` stays fixed.

motion.description: Motion setting → the `data-motion-pref` dial (ThemeProvider `defaultMotionPreference`). "system" (default) follows the OS reduce-motion setting — i.e. full motion whenever the OS is neutral; "reduced" is calm regardless of the OS. The third MotionPreference value, "full", is DELIBERATELY NOT ALLOWED here: `[data-motion-pref="full"]` keeps --motion-factor at 1 through an OS `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` request and opts out of the third-party animation cap that the token stylesheet applies, so it is an informed-consent override a PERSON makes for themselves via a motion control (useMotionPreference()) — never an app default a scaffold imposes on every visitor.

expressiveness.description: How expressive the surface may be, 0-10. This IS the decoration dial (`--decoration` / `data-decoration`) — there is no separate CSS variable. 0 = restrained (default), 10 = full reprographic.

standalone.description: True when the app lives OUTSIDE this monorepo. Standalone scaffolds get the full GitHub-Packages install handoff (.npmrc + `pnpm add` + peers + the CSS @import/@source lines — docs/CONSUMING.md §1-4) and real semver dependency ranges; in-monorepo scaffolds keep `workspace:*`.

release.description: The @elabs/components-* release a standalone app installs (e.g. "2.0.0"). Defaults to the version of the monorepo the scaffold runs in.

surfaces.description: Screens/sections; one archetype per surface, shared app shell.

entities.description: Domain objects → generated interface + ColumnDef<Entity>[] at scaffold time.
